necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes. This monitoring is clinically necessary to identify the etiology of the patient's symptoms given their complex cardiac history.
